maria-cs: Quick Day0 sync for Hightower private deploy. Need go/no-go on routing, egress, KMS cross-account, and CloudTrail delivery. Any blockers?
lee-se: Peering + TGW attached. Missing route to telemetry (10.60.9.0/24). I can add it now.
dina-eng: KMS key policy is account-root only right now customer expects `arn:aws:iam::808070600:role/hightower-ops` to decrypt audit objects.
raj-infra: Added 10.60.9.0/24 -> tgw-55; propagation now "available". Ran curl to collector: TCP ok but 403 response. Collector IP 34.210.99.44 needs whitelist.
audit-bot: cloudtrail_event: "hightower-org-trail" created 2026-04-10T16:12Z
dina-eng: I'll post KMS policy snippet into the runbook. Example: "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::808070600:role/hightower-ops"} + Decrypt/GenerateDataKey.
maria-cs: Risk: if customer doesn't approve KMS statement by Thu, mark renewal at-risk. @lee-se add to tracker.
lee-se: Added risk "KMS cross-account approval delay"; mitigation: temporary ingest key we manage (audit-only), requires amendment.
raj-infra: Customer PM contacted about whitelist. Waiting on confirmation.
dina-eng: Ran local smoke after adding KMS statement in test key: decrypt ok. Recommend adding explicit `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` allow to bucket policy to avoid PutObject 403.
maria-cs: Actions: raj - confirm collector accept after whitelist; lee - track risk and escalate if no reply by Wed EOD; dina - paste final policy into runbook and DM PM. Thanks all :thumbsup:
